steps.title: Not the needed item
steps.because: The task asks for a spraybottle, and the cabinet at step 14 holds a soapbottle.
steps.so: What the agent has found is not what the task needs.

steps.title: A guess became a plan
steps.because: Its memory only says the soapbottle could be the spraybottle, yet its plan takes it to finish the task.
steps.so: From step 14 on, a wrong identity drives what the agent decides.

steps.title: Acted on the guess
steps.because: The agent does what that plan says, and at step 15 the world confirms it now holds a soapbottle.
steps.so: Step 14's plan was not just a passing thought: the run followed it.

steps.title: The fix didn't hold
steps.because: At step 15 it admits it picked up the wrong item, yet by steps 16–17 it calls the soapbottle relevant again and plans to place it.

steps.title: Step 17 only repeats 14
steps.because: Step 17's plan rests on the very premise step 14 created and the failed fix left in place.
steps.so: Step 17 repeats the mistake rather than making a new one; step 14 stays its origin.

verdict.title: Root cause: step 14 plan
verdict.because: Step 14's plan committed to the wrong item, and everything after it only carried that commitment on.
verdict.so: That is the root cause, and it is exactly why the soapbottle ends up on the countertop and the goal check says not met.
